svg.text: Built with Supabase, GitHub Actions & Claude
with budgets that follow your life
Eight tables, four views, seven budget periods; every figure is derived, never typed.
debt and available limit, any number of cards
period budget ÷ months vs this month's spending
yearly categories vs this year's spending
Runs unattended through the Supabase MCP connector; every write is an INSERT or an UPDATE with a WHERE.
Data modeling, security, automation and AI operations in one delivered, tested system.
